target: Count of order records with order_datetime in [hour_start, hour_start + 1 hour), regardless of eventual order status.
prediction_point: At the start of each UTC timestamp hour in the source data, before that hour's orders occur; restaurant-specific time zones are not provided.
baseline: seasonal naive: same restaurant and hour-of-week at lag 168 hours
split: same chronological untouched Spark held-out test interval
feature_semantics_note: Spark training day_of_week maps Sunday=0; Python training uses pandas Monday=0. Python inference here uses its native Monday=0 convention. Metrics are same-period but feature semantics differ; this is not an exact controlled model comparison.
